SELECT g.guide_seq AS guideSeq, g.user_seq AS userSeq, g.title, g.is_public AS isPublic, g.like_count AS likeCount, u.admin_name AS authorName, g.created_at AS createdAt, g.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN gl.like_seq IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS myLiked FROM guide g JOIN admin_user u ON g.user_seq = u.user_seq LEFT JOIN guide_like gl ON g.guide_seq = gl.guide_seq AND gl.user_seq = #{userSeq} WHERE g.use_yn = 'Y' AND (g.is_public = 'Y' OR (g.is_public = 'N' AND g.user_seq = #{userSeq}))
AND g.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY g.created_at DESC
ORDER BY g.like_count DESC, g.created_at DESC
